name: Find Me
storyline:
Find Me is a hide and seek horror game set inside a large, interactive house. Each round begins with a simple call: find me.

You have no time limit. A round only ends when you find the child or when you are killed. Find the right child and the round is won. Survive 8 rounds and morning comes, which means you win the game. Search rooms, open hiding spots, and pay close attention to what you see and hear. Something else is hiding in the house. A demonic child waits in the dark, trying to trick you into finding them. If you do find them, you lose, and the current round restarts. Completed rounds stay completed, so you never replay what you have already cleared.

That other hiding child is not the only thing standing in your way. The further you get into the rounds, the more aggressive and active the demonic presence becomes. You will see horrific monsters and be chased by the Tall One. Horror events are never predictable. You might hear something move, see an apparition, or worse. Explore carefully, trust your gut, and be sure before you look. Watch for obvious signs of the demonic, or listen for what may be hiding on the other side.
summary: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.
